ambient: Quiet HVAC, isolated lamp clicks, footsteps with long room reverb. The break room and service corridor gain warm light and human silhouettes after the review. Silence is meaningful here: no music cue under tasks.

terminal_scenes.task_summary: Write Ada's handover note exactly, using only Caps editing and home-row modifiers that work on practice.
success_criteria: The note equals the target text exactly.
No physical key silenced on practice is needed; the editor accepts the same output either way.

task.prompt: Ada left a handover note full of mistakes. Correct it so the day shift can trust it.
task.initial: handover: kettle ON, lamp 3 stays on, ledgre locked, spare key on the shelf
task.target: Handover: kettle off, lamp 3 stays on, ledger locked, spare key under the plant

steps.needs: Shift capital H (tap-hold F first; H is on the other hand)
Caps + W/B to the word ON, Caps + M or Caps + comma to delete, type "off"
fix "ledgre" with Caps navigation and a forward delete (Caps + comma)
Caps + 4 to the end, delete "on the shelf" (Caps + M repeated) and type "under the plant"

rejects: a note that differs by one character

feedback.diff: The note differs from the target at the marked character. Retry instantly.

dialogue.speaker: ada
dialogue.text: The day shift reads whatever I leave on that desk, so the note has to be exact. Would you fix it with the same habits you used on the lit route? Take your time.

dialogue.speaker: ada
dialogue.text: That is the note I meant to write. Take the little lamp for your own desk: it stays on until someone replaces it.

reward.world: the dawn desk station is lit by the level 19 break-room lighting (station_dawn dead to lit)

pace_signs.text: Walking is working. Walking is working.
Route A: approved. Route A: approved. Route A: approved.

notes: Layout: break room (hub, south-east) -> vestibule nook and glass -> hall with the lit Caps route B and the silent legacy route A -> north stair door -> ledger (north-centre) -> service door -> service corridor (east) -> break room. The loop never needs the old route.

Break room and window: levels.md calls the break room warmly lit in 17 and lighting up in 19. Here the entry anteroom keeps its own lamp pools from the start; the glazed inner lounge behind the long interior window (the kit landmark) is the part that lights in 19.
Practice toggle-out instruction: the exit card is pinned to the HUD from arrival (trigger tr-17-pin-exit-card), repeated on the break-room noticeboard and the ledger noticeboard.
Both the stair door and the service door are modelled with the kit service_door state set (east-wall plane that faces west); the corridor-side face needs the art gap wall_w_plain.
